title: Ordinary Moments
description: Photographer Duncan Wright's work focuses on the histories, communities, and everyday moments experienced through people and places, like this bee landing on a lime in his drink in Hamilton Hill, Western Australia. "I fished it out and placed it on there, watching as it slowly came to before letting it fly off, perhaps to another lime in someone else's drink on that warm summer afternoon," he tells National Geographic.
translated_description: 摄影师邓肯·赖特的作品聚焦于人与地方所承载的历史、社群以及日常瞬间，例如这只落在西澳大利亚州汉密尔顿山他饮料中青柠上的蜜蜂。"我把它捞出来放在那里，看着它慢慢苏醒，然后让它飞走——或许在那个温暖的夏日午后，它会飞向别人杯中另一片青柠。"他告诉《国家地理》。
